params.message:
Colour the network by where each relation's handover stands

With every relation drawn, the picture was a grey knot with a ring of
one-off relations around it, and colouring by importance repeated what
the size already said. The default colouring now shows the handover:
red while the owner carries it alone, amber while it is still to discuss
(on the Bespreken list or five projects or more), green once discussed or
carried by others, light grey for the small ones. A count per colour sits
under the picture and is its legend.

Clients gather on the left, suppliers on the right and contacts on
projects at the top, each side named. The small relations pack together
behind their side without pushing the others, their lines stay hidden
and shared projects pull only lightly, so the big ones keep room for
their names. Lines are faint until a dot is pointed at. High importance
keeps a dark ring, no longer red. The graph gets each relation's carrier
and whether Bespreken lists it.
